title: Air traffic controller watches the F-5 chase

tellings.quote: You know, the object was just playing hideand seek. it would just show up and appear at a very distant point.

plain: In 1986, an unknown object played hide and seek with F-5 fighter jets chasing it over São Paulo, Brazil, popping up again at a very distant point. Jose Manuel Fernandez, an air traffic controller at the city's Congonhas airport, says he watched it happen. He tells it as a witness to show the object moved in ways the jets could not match.
